title: Matchday 10: Ten Names, No New Evidence
summary: The College Football top ten holds because the configured evidence has not changed.
body: The July 24 configured snapshot still supplies the same top ten, model ranks, and first-fixture probabilities as the July 27 opening board, so this is a verification hold rather than a reshuffle.
No listed injury entries or market comparisons appear for the ten; the odds pass was skipped outside the immediate window and title odds are unavailable on the exhausted monthly quota.
The export exposes rank, record-derived context, and immediate fixture context, but not a separate full-schedule-strength measure, market depth, prior-model history, or fresh availability update.

title: Matchday 10: The College Football Opening Board
summary: A cautious top ten baseline: the current board, opening fixtures, and the uncertainty around both.
body: Matchday's first 2026 College Football Matchday 10 is a baseline, not a week-over-week movers list.
The current Top 25 supplies the order; scheduled opening fixtures provide the immediate context.
No opening fixture in the top ten has a market comparison or listed team absence in the current feed.
